Welcome to
RATNAPITH COLLEGE
Ratnapith College was started on the first September, 1978. It was
                                                called Chapar Bahalpur College in its
                                                inception.
                                                After one year, the name was changed to Ratnapith College to signify a
                                                wider concept and some emotional
                                                values.
                                                Ratnapith was the name of one of for divisions of the ancient kingdom of
                                                Kamrup.
